title: Resilience & Hope
intro: By the teenage years the losses are real — friendships that end, results that close doors, families that change shape, weeks where getting up is the achievement. This month refuses both easy answers. It does not say it is fine, and it does not say it is hopeless. It says: this is survivable, you are not the only one, and God is nearest to the broken-hearted.

keyScriptures.text: Suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
The Lord is close to the broken-hearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.

weeks.title: This Is Survivable
weeks.declaration: Whatever this is, it is survivable, and people have survived worse and gone on to have good lives. That is not dismissal. It is evidence.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, when our child cannot see past this week, hold the long view for them. Amen.

weeks.title: God Is Near the Broken-Hearted
weeks.declaration: God does not stand back from sadness waiting for you to cheer up. The consistent testimony of Scripture is that He comes closer.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, be close to our child in the parts of their life we are not shown. Amen.

weeks.title: Ask for Help Early
weeks.declaration: Help asked for early is a conversation. Help asked for late is an emergency. There is no prize for doing it alone.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, make it easy for our child to ask. Remove whatever pride or fear is in the way. Amen.

weeks.title: Hope Is Not Naive
weeks.declaration: Hope is not the belief that nothing bad will happen. It is the refusal to believe that the bad thing gets the final word.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, keep hope alive in our child through a hard season. Anchor it to You rather than to circumstances. Amen.

days.title: Survivable
days.declaration: Whatever this is, it is survivable. People have come through worse and gone on to have genuinely good lives.

scripture.text: The righteous person may have many troubles, but the Lord delivers him from them all.

days.title: Near the Broken-Hearted
days.declaration: God does not wait for you to cheer up before coming close. The pattern in Scripture is the opposite.

scripture.text: The Lord is close to the broken-hearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.

days.title: Not the Only One
days.declaration: Whatever you are struggling with, you are not the only one. It only looks that way from the inside.

scripture.text: No temptation has overtaken you except what is common to mankind.

days.title: Ask Early
days.declaration: Help asked for early is a conversation. Help asked for late is a crisis. There is no medal for doing it alone.

scripture.text: Two are better than one... if either of them falls down, one can help the other up.

days.title: Getting Up Is the Achievement
days.declaration: Some weeks, getting up and going in is the whole achievement. Count it as one.

scripture.text: Though the righteous fall seven times, they rise again.

days.title: Grief Is Not a Malfunction
days.declaration: Sadness that fits the size of what happened is not a malfunction. It is a proportionate response.

scripture.text: Jesus wept.

days.title: Feelings Are Not Forecasts
days.declaration: How you feel today is real, and it is not a prediction. Feelings are weather, not climate.

scripture.text: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him.

days.title: It Will Not Always Be Now
days.declaration: Whatever is heavy right now will not always be now. Seasons genuinely change, including this one.

scripture.text: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.

days.title: The Middle Is the Worst Part
days.declaration: Most stories are worst in the middle. You may simply be in the middle rather than at the end.

scripture.text: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good.

days.title: Failure Is Not Identity
days.declaration: You have failed at something. That is a different sentence from 'you are a failure', and the difference matters.

scripture.text: Though I have fallen, I will rise. Though I sit in darkness, the Lord will be my light.

days.title: Do Not Decide at Night
days.declaration: Things are reliably worse at 2am. Do not make permanent decisions in temporary darkness.

scripture.text: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.

days.title: Rest Is Part of It
days.declaration: Rest is not a reward for finishing. It is part of how you keep going at all.

scripture.text: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

days.title: Small Steps Are Real Steps
days.declaration: On a bad day, one small step counts. You are not obliged to fix everything today.

scripture.text: Do not despise these small beginnings.

days.title: Tell Someone the Actual Truth
days.declaration: 'Fine' costs you more than it saves. Tell one person the actual answer this week.

scripture.text: Confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed.

days.title: You Are Not a Burden
days.declaration: Needing people is not the same as being a burden. The people who love you would rather know.

scripture.text: Carry each other's burdens, and in this way you will fulfil the law of Christ.

days.title: Numbing Postpones It
days.declaration: Numbing a feeling postpones it with interest. Facing it is cheaper, even when it does not feel like it.

scripture.text: Pour out your hearts to him, for God is our refuge.

days.title: Hope Is Not Naive
days.declaration: Hope is not the belief that nothing bad will happen. It is the refusal to let the bad thing have the last word.

scripture.text: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him.

days.title: Anchored, Not Optimistic
days.declaration: Hope is anchored to a person, not to a forecast. That is why it holds when the forecast is bad.

scripture.text: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure.

days.title: You Have a Record
days.declaration: Look at your own record. You have got through every single hard day you have ever had.

scripture.text: Thus far the Lord has helped us.

days.title: Comparison in a Hard Season
days.declaration: Everyone else's life looks smoother because you are seeing the edited version and living the unedited one.

scripture.text: Each one should test their own actions.

days.title: Changing Course
days.declaration: Stopping something that is wrong for you is not quitting. It is paying attention.

scripture.text: The prudent give thought to their steps.

days.title: Kind to Yourself
days.declaration: Talk to yourself the way you would talk to a friend having exactly this week.

scripture.text: Love your neighbour as yourself.

days.title: What You Get Through Becomes Useful
days.declaration: What you survive becomes the thing you can offer someone else later. Not wasted, though it is not a reason it happened.

scripture.text: So that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves receive.

days.title: Perseverance Is Built, Not Issued
days.declaration: Nobody is born resilient. It is built by getting through things, which is the unwelcome but honest answer.

scripture.text: Suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.

days.title: Doors That Close
days.declaration: A closed door is information, not a verdict on you. Very few decisions at your age are final.

scripture.text: What he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.

days.title: Held When You Cannot Hold On
days.declaration: When you cannot hold on, you are being held. You are not the only thing keeping you here.

scripture.text: I am the Lord your God who takes hold of your right hand.

days.title: Not Wasted
days.declaration: None of what you are going through is being wasted, even the parts that make no sense.

scripture.text: In all things God works for the good of those who love him.

days.title: Ask Again Tomorrow
days.declaration: If today's answer was 'keep going', that is enough. You can ask again tomorrow.

scripture.text: His mercies... are new every morning.

days.title: Good Comes Round
days.declaration: This is not the last good thing that will happen to you. Good comes round again, often unannounced.

scripture.text: You turned my wailing into dancing.

days.title: Stronger, Not Just Older
days.declaration: What you are carrying is making you someone who can carry more. That is not a consolation; it is a fact.

scripture.text: The testing of your faith produces perseverance... so that you may be mature and complete.

days.title: Keep the Evidence
days.declaration: What you have got through this month is evidence for the next hard thing. Keep the evidence.

scripture.text: Perseverance produces character; and character, hope.
